snippet.title: Villain Project - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
An original storytelling puzzle about a young student who will learn things like theft, magic, and gay sex. Each image is like a chapter of a book. To understand the whole story, complete all levels and check Leopold and his adventure, his practice session, and his final test.

Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227600/Villain_Project/

Available on Itch.io: https://maledollstudio.itch.io/villain-project

#SupportLGBTQ+Developers
